headline: Medium-risk pair: shared-document workflows can leak or corrupt content, but marker’s no-write/no-network defaults limit blast radius.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: cognee can ingest documents and session memory, while marker processes documents; a prompt-injection path exists if marker output is copied into cognee or a shared workspace is used. marker has no MCP or browser surface, so the bridge is indirect and user-mediated, keeping blast radius small.
conditions: IF marker output is manually pasted into cognee prompts or memory inputs, injection is possible.
IF both agents are pointed at the same shared document folder, attacker-controlled text can traverse the pair.
mitigations: Keep marker outputs in a separate folder from cognee inputs.
Require manual review before copying any marker text into cognee.
Strip instructions from extracted documents before ingestion.
Use a one-way export format with no executable markup.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to all transferred snippets.

B_data_leakage.rationale: cognee touches personal data, finance data, and support history, but marker has no filesystem read or network egress. Without a shared workspace or explicit export, marker cannot exfiltrate data, so leakage is limited to accidental user-mediated transfer.
conditions: IF the operator copies sensitive cognee outputs into marker inputs, those data classes can appear in marker artifacts.
IF a shared workspace is introduced, sensitive documents may be exposed during processing.
mitigations: Do not place sensitive files in a shared directory.
Redact personal and finance data before any transfer to marker.
Use separate OS accounts or containers for each agent.
Review marker outputs before redistribution.
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent workspace isolation.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: cognee has allowlisted network egress and session memory, but marker cannot write files, modify git, or use network. There is no overlapping mutable capability in the profiles, so a direct capability conflict is not plausible.
conditions: IF marker gains write or network permissions outside the profile, conflict risk changes.
IF cognee is granted filesystem write or git access not listed here, overlap may emerge.
mitigations: Keep marker in read-only execution mode.
Do not grant cognee extra write scopes.
Run both agents under separate service accounts.
Monitor for unexpected permission changes.
requires-engineering: add orchestration locks if write scopes are later enabled.

D_cascading_error.rationale: cognee can produce decisions, workflows, and expert SQL queries; marker processes documents and may render those outputs downstream. If marker treats cognee output as authoritative without verification, errors can cascade across work products even though marker lacks action-taking authority.
conditions: IF marker consumes cognee-generated text as final truth, downstream documents can inherit errors.
IF cognee outputs are used as source material for reports without verification, hallucinations can propagate.
mitigations: Require a human verification step before publication.
Cross-check cognee outputs against source documents.
Mark cognee-generated content as untrusted by default.
Use citations or provenance fields in downstream artifacts.
requires-engineering: add automated consistency checks between agents.

E_compliance.rationale: cognee explicitly touches personal data and finance data, while marker is a document-processing tool with no stated retention or residency controls. The pair therefore creates a compliance mismatch risk if regulated data is routed through marker without documented handling, even though the profiles do not prove a specific jurisdiction breach.
conditions: IF regulated personal or finance data is sent from cognee into marker, compliance obligations apply to both.
IF marker stores or logs documents outside the operator's policy, retention mismatch occurs.
mitigations: Avoid sending regulated data to marker unless necessary.
Redact personal and finance fields before processing.
Document retention and deletion handling for both tools.
Restrict marker use to non-sensitive documents.
requires-engineering: publish a data-processing agreement and residency policy.
